_readme: Live settings for Nebula Forge. Edit, commit to main, and GitHub Pages serves it within a minute or two; the app picks it up at next launch or foreground. Every key is optional — delete one and the app falls back to the value it shipped with. Values outside the ranges below are rejected by the client, not clamped, so a typo means 'use the built-in value' rather than 'use the boundary'.
_forgeCostGrowth: Optional. 1.02-1.5. Ships as 1.12. How fast forging gets more expensive within a run. Lower = longer runs.
_prestigePowerRequirement: Optional. 1-100000. Ships as 12. Galaxy Power needed before a Supernova is allowed.
_arrayCostMultiplier: Optional. 0.25-4. Ships as 1. Scales every Starlight Array price. Below 1 is a sale.
_event: Optional. Multipliers applied while inside the window. production and shards are each 1-5. Omit startsAt to begin immediately; omit endsAt to never expire. Dates are ISO-8601 with an offset, e.g. 2026-08-15T00:00:00Z. An event with neither multiplier is ignored.
_notice: Optional. A line of text under the banners. body is capped at 140 characters. Omit endsAt to show it indefinitely.

notice.body: Thanks for playing the launch build.
